summary: Rahul (AE) and Sameer Joshi (Procurement Manager) held a procurement negotiation call on 2026-06-24. Sameer requested a 15% discount and net‑60 terms, which Rahul countered with a 5% discount for a two‑year commitment plus a joint case study. Sameer accepted the 5% discount, the two‑year term, and net‑45 payment terms, agreeing to send the contract paper and sign the agreement within the week.

objections.text: Standard ask — fifteen percent off, and net-60 payment terms.
objections.how_handled: Offered 5% discount for two-year commitment and case study, which was accepted

buying_signals: Willing to do joint case study
